batch.selection: Microsoft 405 份待审母集按冻结顺序排列的第 5 批 60 份资料
batch.admissionRule: 总分至少 6/10，且知识重要性至少 2/3

results.title: Evaluate your AI agents
results.description: Learn how to evaluate AI agents using built-in evaluators for quality, safety, and agent-specific behaviors.

scores.rationale: 代理评测同时覆盖质量、安全、工具调用和任务行为，是生产代理系统的核心门禁。

results.title: Evaluation dataset schema in Microsoft Foundry
results.description: Learn the standard fields and supported shapes for turn-level, conversation-level, agent, and simulation seed evaluation datasets.

scores.rationale: 统一的单轮、会话、代理和仿真数据模式决定评测结果能否比较与复现。

results.title: Generate a synthetic evaluation dataset (preview)
results.description: Generate Simple Q&A and simulation seed datasets in Microsoft Foundry from an agent, prompt, or reference file for single-turn and multi-turn evaluation.

scores.rationale: 合成单轮与多轮评测集能补足真实数据稀缺和边界场景覆盖，但处于预览。

results.title: Evaluation datasets in Microsoft Foundry
results.description: Learn how evaluation datasets are structured, how to prepare them, and how Microsoft Foundry uses them in evaluation runs.

scores.rationale: 评测数据集总览建立结构与准备流程，但详细增量主要来自模式专题。

results.title: Monitor agents with the Agent Monitoring Dashboard
results.description: Learn how to monitor operational metrics, token usage, latency, and evaluation results for AI agents in Microsoft Foundry by using the Agent Monitoring Dashboard and Application Insights.

scores.rationale: 监控面板统一运行指标、令牌、延迟与评测结果，是线上代理观测的重要实践。

results.title: Set up human evaluation for your agents (preview)
results.description: Learn how to set up human evaluation for your Microsoft Foundry agents, create templates, and analyze results to improve agent performance.

scores.rationale: 人工评测为主观质量、复杂任务和模型裁判校准提供不可缺少的真实判断。

results.title: Log end user feedback (preview)
results.description: Learn how to log end user feedback such as thumbs up/down or rating scales from your AI application using OpenTelemetry semantics in Microsoft Foundry.

scores.rationale: 基于 OpenTelemetry 记录终端用户反馈把真实体验信号接入持续评测闭环。

results.title: Optimize agent prompts by using Prompt Optimizer (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use Prompt Optimizer in Microsoft Foundry to automatically improve your agent's system instructions using AI-driven prompt engineering best practices.

scores.rationale: 自动提示优化明确候选生成与评价循环，是官方独有能力边界且实践价值高。

results.title: Configure tracing for AI agent frameworks (preview)
results.description: Debug issues and monitor AI agent performance in production by configuring OpenTelemetry tracing for LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, and OpenAI Agents SDK.

scores.rationale: 跨 LangChain、LangGraph 等框架的 OpenTelemetry 追踪提供可迁移观测契约。

results.title: Review agent interactions with Trace Replay (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use Trace Replay in Microsoft Foundry to navigate, filter, and analyze conversation traces from agent runs.

scores.rationale: Trace Replay 把多轮代理交互按时间与工具调用重放，具有独特诊断价值。

results.title: Set up tracing in Microsoft Foundry
results.description: Learn how to set up tracing in Microsoft Foundry to debug AI agent runs and monitor behavior by sending telemetry to Azure Monitor Application Insights with OpenTelemetry.

scores.rationale: 追踪设置页提供最小遥测管线契约，达到保留线但以 Foundry 配置为主。

results.title: Annotate traces with human feedback (preview)
results.description: Learn how to annotate traces with thumbs up or thumbs down feedback in Microsoft Foundry to track quality signals directly on production traces.

scores.rationale: 在生产轨迹上叠加人工反馈能形成可定位、可回放的质量证据。

results.title: Configure Microsoft Entra authentication for Foundry agent trace ingestion (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use Microsoft Entra authentication for Foundry Agent trace ingestion to Application Insights with managed identities and RBAC.

scores.rationale: Entra、托管身份和 RBAC 配置属于 Azure 身份接入，通用 AI 知识增量不足。

results.title: Restrict access to sensitive content in Microsoft Foundry traces (preview)
results.description: Learn how to protect sensitive generative AI trace data in Microsoft Foundry by routing it to a dedicated table and restricting access with Azure role-based access control.

scores.rationale: 敏感轨迹的分表、访问限制和治理直接处理可观测性与隐私之间的冲突。

results.title: Convert agent traces into evaluation datasets (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use data generation in Microsoft Foundry to turn production agent traces into evaluation and fine-tuning datasets.

scores.rationale: 把生产轨迹转为评测和微调数据连接了真实失败、离线验证与后续改进。

results.title: Abuse monitoring

scores.rationale: 滥用监控的检测、审查和响应边界是托管大模型安全治理的官方核心信息。

results.title: System message design

scores.rationale: 系统消息对行为、控制与安全的影响具有广泛价值，但提示原则并非品牌独有。

results.title: Groundedness detection filter
results.description: Learn how to use groundedness detection in Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry Models to validate LLM responses against source documents for RAG scenarios.

scores.rationale: Groundedness 检测验证回答与来源证据的一致性，是 RAG 幻觉控制的关键机制。

results.title: Personally identifiable information (PII) filter

scores.rationale: PII 过滤明确个人信息识别和输出拦截边界，对隐私保护不可替代。

results.title: Prompt Shields in Microsoft Foundry

scores.rationale: Prompt Shields 分离用户攻击与文档攻击，是提示注入防御的重要官方机制。

scores.rationale: 受保护文本与代码检测给出版权风险控制边界，独特但适用范围较集中。
